item.title: FAQ
item.author: Unknown
item.description:
Common Questions

What is Remote Support?

I connect to your computer using secure remote access software. You can see everything I’m doing on your screen. Most issues can be resolved this way, and we both get to stay home. 😉

Securty during Remote Sessions

I use industry-standard remote access tools. You can watch everything happening on screen, and you can disconnect the session at any time. I do not store any of your personal data.

What if your problem can’t be fixed remotely?

I offer in-home support in Haldimand and Norfolk County.

What payments do I accept?

Interac e-Transfer for all invoiced work. Cash is also accepted for in-home visits.

Do I work on Macs or other Apple products?

My focus is Windows and Linux systems. I have limited experience repairing and supporting Apple devices. If you have a Mac/Apple related question, feel free to reach out — I may still be able to help.

Do you sell computer parts?

For custom builds, I help you choose the right parts for your budget and build the system for you. You purchase the parts directly (I can send you the links), or I can order them on your behalf.

What are my hours of operation?

Monday to Friday, 9am–5pm. I respond to all inquiries within 24 business hours.

Where do you begin?

Fill out the Service Request Form, or email mail@jmit.ca. I’ll respond within 24 hours.
